name: physwhen
description: Evidence-based argument structuring for theoretical-physics writing

interface.longDescription: Write and revise English theoretical-physics papers from supplied drafts or research notes. Organize arguments and improve prose while preserving equations, results, and assumptions. Includes source-traceable references; does not detect AI authorship or claim proven readability gains.
defaultPrompt: Use PhysWhen to revise this paper.
Use PhysWhen to draft a paper from these research notes.
Use PhysWhen to improve this paragraph.
